summary: Request access to Dedicated SLO dashboards (Console) for CS/SE supporting Lattice Health
description:
Requester: Rachel Kim (Dir CS Enterprise)
Needed for: Markus Klein (Dir Solutions Engineering) + CS Enterprise on-call coverage
Customer/account: Lattice Health (Dedicated)
Request: Grant read-only access to the new Dedicated SLO dashboards in Redwood Console (tiered SLO views: availability/error-rate, latency p50/p95/p99, streaming disconnect accounting) for the Lattice Health account.

Business context:
- Active customer escalation on EU latency spikes and SLO reporting expectations (see SUP-28455).
- Customer requested screenshots/exportable views for weekly reliability review and a clear explanation of what is included/excluded.

What access is needed:
- Console: Dedicated SLO dashboard read access scoped to Lattice Health account (account-level and region-level views).
- Ability to view error budget status badge + last 7/30d trend panels.
- No write access to routing policies, alert rules, or SLO config.

People requiring access:
1) Markus Klein (Solutions Engineering)
2) Rachel Kim (CS Enterprise)
3) SE on-call group: Solutions Engineering (for backup coverage)

Constraints/notes:
- Access must be least-privilege and auditable.
- Use the standard role/group if available (e.g., console role: dedicated_slo_viewer) and account scoping.
- If temporary access is required, set an expiry date and note it here.

Approvals requested:
- CS leadership approval: Jasmine Liu (VP CS) or delegate
- Data access owner approval (if required by RBAC policy): SLO Dashboard backend owner (Felix Schneider) / Console integration owner (Chloe Martin)

Acceptance criteria:
- Markus/Rachel can open the Dedicated SLO dashboard for Lattice Health and filter by region without permission errors.
- Access is reflected in RBAC audit log.
- Confirmation posted back on this ticket and in #support (optional).
comments: 2026-02-12 09:18 PT — Rachel Kim: Creating internal ticket per process. Customer is asking for SLO reporting and we need to self-serve the Console dashboard during calls. Linking SUP-28455. Requesting read-only access for Markus + CS Enterprise team.
2026-02-12 10:02 PT — Chloe Martin: Acknowledged. We have the new Dedicated SLO dashboards behind RBAC. Need confirmation on which users + whether access should be account-scoped only (recommended).
2026-02-12 10:11 PT — Rachel Kim: Account-scoped only please. Users: Markus Klein, Rachel Kim. Also requesting that the SE on-call group be included if possible (to avoid repeat tickets).

2026-02-12 10:27 PT — Jasmine Liu: Approved for Rachel + Markus. For broader groups, prefer named users unless there’s an on-call requirement. If there is an SE on-call rotation that needs it, scope it tightly and add an expiry/review reminder.

2026-02-12 11:03 PT — Felix Schneider: From dashboard side: please use role `console:dedslo:readonly` + account scope `acct_lattice_health_*`. No need for metrics backend direct access; Console proxy handles it. Make sure the role does not include trace/log deep links that reveal other accounts.

2026-02-12 12:22 PT — Chloe Martin: Implementing via RBAC admin. Plan:
- Add Markus Klein + Rachel Kim to Okta group `console-dedicated-slo-readonly`.
- Apply account scope for Lattice Health only (scope token `acct_9f3c...` in Console RBAC).
- No expiry for named users; will review in 60 days.
- Not adding broad SE group yet; will follow up once we confirm roster/need.

2026-02-12 13:05 PT — Chloe Martin: Done. Both users added and scope applied. RBAC audit entry: `RBAC-2026-02-12T21:04:31Z` (add principal -> role console:dedslo:readonly, scope acct_9f3c...). Can you confirm you can access the dashboard?

2026-02-12 13:22 PT — Markus Klein: Confirmed. I can access Console → Reliability → Dedicated SLOs for Lattice Health and see EU-West latency panels + error budget badge. No access to other accounts (as expected).
2026-02-12 13:34 PT — Rachel Kim: Confirmed as well. This unblocks our customer call tomorrow.
2026-02-14 09:10 PT — Chloe Martin: Closing as complete. Follow-up: if SE on-call needs access, please open a new INT ticket with the exact group name + manager approval + desired expiry.
resolution: Granted account-scoped read-only Console access to Dedicated SLO dashboards for Lattice Health to Markus Klein and Rachel Kim. Access applied via RBAC role `console:dedslo:readonly` with Lattice Health account scope; audit entry recorded (RBAC-2026-02-12T21:04:31Z).
internal_notes: Do not grant broad group access without explicit on-call need + expiry. Dashboard deep links must remain account-scoped; avoid enabling cross-account trace/log access. If customer requests exported reports, route to CS playbook and confirm what’s supported (screenshots/CSV from Console vs custom report).
